brief: Prioritise Harrowgate Ridge for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Review any outstanding work against the unit's ability to shed heat, prioritising failed cooling, obstructed airflow, or oil leaks for completion before the event begins (SOP-016). If an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
